meta.title: Publishing an RFP that ends after its RFQ is refused with 712
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup recipe does not specify that the technical RFP ends after the pricing RFQ.
The publish_event operation does not expose a listed token for the technical round UUID, so the request cannot explicitly set both stage UUIDs in draft_trade_request_uuids.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals draft.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. Please adjust.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals draft.
